planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription from the depicted connectivity and formal charge; this is the natural single route for this image-grounded conversion task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the diagram and ignore the curved arrows. Read the remaining structure as an R2 substituent attached to an unlabeled carbon, that carbon triple-bonded to nitrogen, nitrogen bearing a positive charge, and nitrogen single-bonded to R1.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to know that the requested output is the SMILES expression and that arrows in the transition-state drawing should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: generic R substituents are represented by wildcard atoms `*`; an unlabeled skeletal atom in this context is carbon `C`; a triple bond is `#`; positively charged nitrogen is bracketed as `[N+]`; single bonds may be omitted by adjacency.
